title: OP-18 Japan: official pages now list 21 Nov, ¥240 a pack
detail: A retailer summary of Bandai's pages says the Japanese OP-18 went on sale Sat 21 Nov (24 packs per box). I did not open Bandai's pages myself and could not confirm shops actually shipped on the day. Retailer lists later Japanese sets as EB-06 on 30 Jan 2027 and OP-19 on 27 Feb 2027 (unconfirmed).

title: Latin America Internationals ends today; Champions League Chiba is also today
detail: Final day in São Paulo (20–22 Nov) and Champions League Chiba (Japan) both fall on 22 Nov. No results found yet. Limitless's list shows nothing after Buenos Aires (14 Nov, Calvin Connor), so check tomorrow. Regional Stuttgart is Sat 28 Nov.

title: Limitless no longer lists Oklahoma City; next regional is Alicante, Sat 28 Nov
detail: Oklahoma City (21 Nov) has dropped off the upcoming list but no results are posted yet (unconfirmed). Bristol also isn't listed. Next listed: Alicante 28 Nov, then 5 Dec (Santiago, Mexico City, Munich, Utrecht), 6 Dec Peoria, 12 Dec Paris, Montréal and Kissimmee.
